name: encoder_decoder
description: Encode or decode text using Base64, hexadecimal, URL encoding, ROT13, binary, or ASCII codes, or detect what encoding a given string might already be in.

action.description: Pick the exact operation. rot13 is its own inverse (same action for encode/decode). detect_encoding guesses what format an unknown string might be in.

text.description: The text/string to process - the input being encoded, decoded, or detected.
